authority.canonical_source_of_truth: Canonical source files in library/organization/specs/*.spec.md and library/organization/skills/**/SKILL.md are authoritative for overlapping metadata.
authority.catalog_role_when_overlap: The catalog is a derived, machine-readable index that must remain synchronized with canonical frontmatter; tooling should treat divergence as a validation error.

versioning.artifact_version_contract: artifact_version is per-artifact semver and may change independently of repository release tags.
versioning.repository_release_tag_contract: A repository release tag (for gh skill install --pin) identifies an immutable release manifest snapshot.

lifecycle_policy.breaking_change_policy: A breaking change requires a major artifact version bump and inclusion in a new repository release manifest tag.
lifecycle_policy.staged_external_policy: Staged or external artifacts are tracked with external-source and staging-disposition records and are not treated as first-party lifecycle entries.
